claim_summary: HydroAgent is a skill-orchestrated flood forecasting workflow that places an LLM-driven analog prior judgment and human review gates around a deterministic Xinanjiang model, evaluated with five LLMs.

claim_evidence.quote: To address this issue, we propose HydroAgent, a skill-orchestrated agent framework that embeds Large Language Models (LLMs)

modules.name: Flood forecasting skill workflow with expert review gates
modules.scope_reason: Step 0-4 chain, flood outputs (peak, volume, warning level) and review gates are embedded in the procedure; a different task family would require redesigning the chain (R3_1 counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - flood peak, volume and warning outputs embedded in the chain

evidence.quote: HydroAgent workflow includes five steps: (1) scheme preparation, (2) scenario judgment, (3) scheme selection, (4) rolling forecasting, and (5) warning bulletin.
to await expert approval before advancing

modules.name: Analog-case flood prior judgment with physical red-line check
modules.scope_reason: Peak and volume prior ranges are derived from flood-specific similarity rules and runoff constraints; a new task family would change the rules (R3_1 counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - flood peak and volume interval rules embedded

evidence.quote: a six-dimensional similarity retrieval is performed in which the executor computes a weighted score over the historical case library
Third, before the prior judgment is finalized, a physical red-line validation verifies

modules.name: Flood-type-indexed XAJ parameter library and scheme selection
modules.scope_reason: Event typing by peak-flow thresholds and selection against Step 1 ranges are flood-specific (R3_1 counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - scheme library indexed by flood peak classes selected against flood judgment ranges

evidence.quote: Calibration yields one XAJ parameter set per flood
Selected the optimal parameter set from the Step 0 scheme library, matching Step 1 constraints.

process_validity.quote: All five state-of-the-art large language models successfully execute the workflow

temporal_validity.quote: A subset of 113 events from 1995–2019 was used as the historical case library and as the calibration set for the Step 0 XAJ parameter schemes.

task_performance.quote: with Pearson correlation coefficients (r) of 0.62 and 0.84 between observed values and predicted midpoints for peak flow and flood volume, respectively.

notes: Role is a judgment call: the work calls itself an agent, but the step order is fixed and only human review verdicts (rollback) change the next action. The LLM is used off the shelf (GPT-5.4 and four others) with no training, so no LLM-side module. No GTS module is assigned: the chronological split and the retrieval-pool restriction in cross-validation are evaluation design, and Step 3 rolling updating is described in one sentence.
